iconicAnchor.label: Twentieth-century fashion photography and magazine spreads
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Fashion photographers, stylists, art directors, and publications
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The V&A survey establishes fashion editorial as a collaboration among garment, model, pose, setting, photography, and publication context rather than ordinary portraiture with fashionable clothing.

sources.title: 100 years of fashion photography
supports: Fashion photography developed through deliberate staging, changing ideals, and strong relationships with editorial publication.
The examples support art-directed figure, garment clarity, and period-specific photographic decisions.

sources.title: Collection selection boxes: Fashion Photography 1910–Present
supports: The collection framework treats fashion photography as a century-long field with distinct editorial approaches, not a single luxury look.
The institutional selection supports comparing pose, styling, crop, and publication context across examples.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches art directed fashion, photographic, controlled asymmetry, full bleed, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/fashion-editorial/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
